classification.rationale: An incident postmortem analysing an outage, its root cause, timeline and action items.

summarization.headline: A connection-pool misconfiguration caused an 87-minute Payment API outage affecting about 21,000 transactions.
key_points: 38% of card payment requests failed between 14:05 and 15:32 UTC on October 2, 2025.
summarization.title: Incident Postmortem: Payment API Outage
key_findings: Connection-pool size was reduced from 200 to 20 in a routine configuration change
Requests queued under peak load until they timed out
recommendations: Validate connection-pool settings automatically before deployment
Require a second reviewer for production configuration changes
